lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five distinct horizontal rows with relatively uniform spacing in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side to lower-intensity shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density patterning of small, uniform high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more densely clustered than the larger blobs observed on the main lateral flank.
